mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST does not lead to negative 60-day returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signals impending monetary tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals economic contraction, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market strength, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Weak consumer spending (RSAFS growth < 0.5%) signals reduced demand, lowering corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS growth < 0.5%.
